## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `mvn verify` passes locally
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated
- [ ] Docker/Compose behavior was validated when applicable
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or configuration changed

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, or sensitive test data were added
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, input validation, or transport changes were reviewed
- [ ] File-upload/storage changes were reviewed for path traversal and resource limits

## Deployment impact

- [ ] Configuration/environment variables changed
- [ ] Database/schema migration required
- [ ] Docker image or Compose behavior changed
- [ ] Release notes or upgrade instructions required

## Notes for reviewers

Call out compatibility concerns, trade-offs, known limitations, or follow-up work.
